messages:
marie-docs: heads up — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1987 with the migration guide for private deployments. contains an SDK example that shows a mock KMS payload. marking as sensitive and requesting security+legal signoff before merge. will block if needed.

sam-security: thanks @marie-docs. can you point to the exact snippet lines? quick scan shows an inline key-looking string in the Node sample. we should redact that before preview.

marie-docs: yep — in the file private/migration.md, code block starting at the "Node SDK example" header. lines ~120-128 have `const key = "sk-live-EXAMPLE-abc123"`. i put a TODO but left the sample for clarity.

alex-legal: please add a redaction request in the legal queue (link: https://legal.redwood.internal/requests) so we have a short audit trail. we can expedite if security confirms it's a non-production artifact.

jordan-eng: from an engineering POV it's fine to replace with `const key = "REDACTED_KMS_TOKEN"` and include a note that customers must supply their own. no functional loss.

marie-docs: i'll make that change now. quick q — we have a docs preview scheduled; does the preview bot push automatically on merge or on PR update? we might want to pause preview until redaction is in to avoid leaking the snippet.

docs-preview-bot: docs-preview-bot: preview for PR #1987 scheduled at 2025-06-01T14:05Z. builds: 1 pending, 0 failed. To cancel, add the label `preview-cancel`.

sam-security: thanks for the heads up. @marie-docs please replace the key, and then ping me. if you can't update in the next 30m, we'll add the `preview-cancel` label so the site doesn't show the sensitive example.

marie-docs: pushed change; replaced with `REDACTED_KMS_TOKEN` and added an inline note: "DO NOT paste real keys here — example only." also added a test to assert no `sk-live-` pattern in docs.

ben-ci: ben-ci: CI checks for PR #1987 — docs-lint: passed, link-check: passed, secret-scan: failed (detected pattern in previous commit). current HEAD is clean. rerun required -> restarted checks (job 4521).

sam-security: i ran a quick grep on the rebuilt artifact, no matches. i'm good to sign off from security. marking approved: sam-security :white_check_mark:.

alex-legal: legal reviewed the wording for obligations around customer keys. a couple of tiny edits suggested inline. once applied, legal signs off. i can approve remotely.

marie-docs: applied legal wording tweaks (`note about customer responsibility`), CI green. @alex-legal @sam-security — can i get explicit approvals so i can merge before the end of day? merging helps unblock a downstream migration doc.

alex-legal: alex-legal: approved. added comment linking the legal request ID #LR-3321.

sam-security: sam-security: approved. thanks for the quick redaction.

marie-docs: thanks all — merging in 10m and will watch the post-merge publish. will DM if anything else pops up. :pray:

ben-ci: ben-ci: merge detected. docs site build started (build 7890). watch at https://ci.redwood-inference/builds/7890.

docs-preview-bot: docs-preview-bot: new version of the migration guide live on staging in ~6 minutes.

jordan-eng: nice, thanks team. low-risk, good example of cross-team gating.
